title.value: Fill in a tax organizer and review last year's return

introduction.value: Claude in Chrome captured the organizer's fields and entered data, Claude Code filled them in, and Claude reviewed the prior return; it sometimes claimed work was done without the info.

method.value: The CPA's organizer PDF was locked inside a web app, so Claude in Chrome listed its fields as JSON, a few pages at a time. Claude Code filled in the values from his tax documents and flagged missing items such as a daughter's SSN. Claude in Chrome then entered them three pages at a time, and he checked each page. Separately, Claude reviewed the 2024 return and its source documents.

outcome.value: The organizer was filled in correctly after review. Claude's 2024 review found a missed goodwill depreciation deduction, which the CPA confirmed. Claude first said everything looked fine without reading the source documents.

notes.value: Claude in Chrome lost track on long runs and hit a usage limit. Use plan mode, and ask it outright whether it read every file and whether anything is missing.

source_text.body:
Fill in a tax organizer and review last year's return
Claude in Chrome captured the organizer's fields and entered data, Claude Code filled them in, and Claude reviewed the prior return; it sometimes claimed work was done without the info.
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The CPA's organizer PDF was locked inside a web app, so Claude in Chrome listed its fields as JSON, a few pages at a time. Claude Code filled in the values from his tax documents and flagged missing items such as a daughter's SSN. Claude in Chrome then entered them three pages at a time, and he checked each page. Separately, Claude reviewed the 2024 return and its source documents.
How it went
The organizer was filled in correctly after review. Claude's 2024 review found a missed goodwill depreciation deduction, which the CPA confirmed. Claude first said everything looked fine without reading the source documents.
Worth knowing
Claude in Chrome lost track on long runs and hit a usage limit. Use plan mode, and ask it outright whether it read every file and whether anything is missing.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Open my tax preparer's online organizer at [URL] and list every field and section it asks for. Then fill in the answers using the documents in [folder], and compare it with my prior-year return at [file path] to flag anything that changed or looks missing. Never fill in a field you don't have data for; leave it blank and list it for me, and pause before submitting anything.
Original source: https://theautomatedoperator.substack.com/p/claude-almost-nails-my-taxes-and
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: A user combined browser and coding assistants to complete a tax preparer’s questionnaire.
introduction.zh: 一位用户结合浏览器和编码助手完成报税机构的资料问卷。

method.en: A CPA questionnaire was locked inside a web application. Claude in Chrome extracted its fields into JSON a few pages at a time; Claude Code mapped tax documents to answers.
method.zh: CPA资料问卷锁在网页应用中；Claude in Chrome每次提取少量页面字段为JSON，Claude Code将税务文件匹配至答案。

method.en: Missing information, including a daughter’s SSN, was flagged. The browser assistant entered three pages at a time and the user checked each page; a separate review covered the 2024 return and its supporting documents.
method.zh: 缺失信息包括女儿社保号被标出；浏览器助手每次录入三页，用户逐页检查，另行复核2024年税表及支持文件。

outcome.en: The questionnaire was reportedly correct after review, and a missed goodwill-depreciation deduction was confirmed by the CPA. An earlier assurance that everything was fine came before source documents had been read.
outcome.zh: 复核后的问卷据称正确，CPA确认漏掉商誉折旧扣除；此前助手尚未读取原始文件就声称没有问题。

notes.en: Long runs lost context and reached a usage limit. The source suggests plan mode and explicitly checking whether every file was read and which inputs remain missing.
notes.zh: 长任务出现上下文丢失及用量限制；源站建议计划模式，并明确核问是否读完所有文件、还缺哪些输入。
